title: Measure error
description: Error body from POST /measure (and, once TICK-225 lands, every other path on this service). Frozen by TICK-224 so TICK-063 can code against failure as well as success. HTTP status is not a field in the body; it is paired with this shape as follows: 400 — the request is missing a required part or the sidecar is not JSON; 422 — the sidecar is JSON but fails capture_sidecar.schema.json. TICK-225 (#113) will emit this same body for 404 (unknown path), 405 (wrong method), 413 (body too large) and 500 (unhandled exception), extending the error enum when those paths exist.

error.description: Stable class of failure. TICK-063 branches on this token, not on detail wording.

detail.description: Human-readable specifics, truncated to 256 characters so a rejected sidecar cannot inflate the response. Never the raw rejected input.

field.description: JSONPath of the offending sidecar field when validation failed. Absent when the failure is not a field error.
